title: Con Edison Crews Restore Service to 15,200 Customers Affected by Nor’easter
summary: Con Edison has restored electric service to about 15,200 customers who lost power due to the intense rain and windstorm that swept through the region.
body_markdown:
Con Edison has restored electric service to 15,200


customers


who lost power due to the intense rain and windstorm that swept through the region. Company crews are


working to restore about 11,500


who remain without service.


Westchester County was especially hard hit with 9,200 customers losing service. The company has restored 2,300 of those and is working to restore the 6,900 who remain out of service.


Crews are still working on scattered outages in New York City and Westchester County


. The company has brought in 130 mutual aid workers to supplement its own crews.


It is possible that there might still be wires down in some neighborhoods. **The company urges members of the public to stay away from any wires that are downed during storms.** Call your local police department or 1-800-75-CONED (1-800-752-6633) to report downed wires.


Con Edison may assign workers to guard downed wires and keep people and pets away from them. These workers may be in unmarked vehicles, but they carry Con Edison identification.


Customers can also report outages and check service restoration status at


[conEd.com/reportoutage](https://www.coned.com/en/services-and-outages/report-track-service-issue/report-outage-status) , with Con Edison’s mobile app for


[iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/con-edison/id654677047) or


[Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.coned.conedison&hl=en_US) devices, or by calling 1-800-75-CONED (1-800-752-6633).
